exposure: Reason for referral (e.g., hypertensive disorder of pregnancy)
cohort: Critically ill obstetric women referred to VMMC and Safdarjung Hospital in New Delhi.
finding: The referral rate to obstetric ICU ranged from 39-47% over five years, primarily due to hypertensive disorders, with most women transferred without escorts, prior communication, or complete referral slips.
cross-section timing: Retrospective audit conducted from September 2018 to 2023.
